items.title: The Cech complex of pushforwards of the restrictions is a resolution of the O_X-module
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves), section on the Cech complex
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma exhibits a resolution of an arbitrary O_X-module F by the product-of-pushforwards complex C^p(U,F) = prod_{i_0...i_p} (j_{i_0...i_p})_* F_{i_0...i_p} attached to an open covering U : X = bigcup_{i in I} U_i, with the Cech differential of equation-d-cech (statement lines 4573-4594). The proof does not chase the Cech complex globally: it reduces the quasi-isomorphism to exactness at every stalk and then writes down an explicit contracting homotopy h which inserts a fixed index i_fix in front of a cochain, the same formula in degree 0 supplying the augmentation C^0(U,F)_x -> F_x (proof lines 4604-4623). The verification is the displayed three-line computation of (dh + hd)(s)_{i_0...i_p}, in which the reindexed boundary terms occur twice with opposite signs and cancel, leaving s_{i_0...i_p}, so that h is a homotopy from the identity of the extended complex to zero (proof lines 4624-4652). What has to be supplied by hand is exactly this homotopy together with the observation that the doubly indexed section is defined over U_{i_0...i_p}; nothing beyond the Cech differential is imported. The claim is H2.
